_about: Geyser control schedule for 1A Welgemeend. Edited by Werner (or Claude on Werner's say-so). The logger enforces it every 30 minutes and may only set the geyser's switch and Block1-4.

keep_warm._note: Irregular showers: hold the tank at 55+ all day, reheat to 65. Midday the solar collector gets first go while it is working, unless the tank drops below 45.

_element_kw_note: Effective rate, not the 3.4 kW nameplate: the sensor sits next to the element and cuts it off early, so it runs ~35-45% of the time while heating (measured 28 Oct 04:00-06:00).
